releaseNotes: Smart Life v0.11.72 adds the requested direct Add to Category action to every result in Files > Search. After finding any indexed file, the user can tap the new folder-plus action, choose an existing Smart Life category or create a new one, and finish without sharing the file through Inbox. The original Android file is never moved or duplicated; Smart Life stores only the category assignment. Existing Search filters, thumbnails, file opening, Share behavior, Category management, Home, Notes, Library, Settings, TikTok, Instagram and Facebook flows remain unchanged.
